workingTree: Uncommitted local implementation; no deployment, commit or hosted certification.

environment.targets: Loopback Next production builds and PostgreSQL 16 on one shared Windows host; no provider I/O.

limitations: End-to-end scheduled request through full HTTP body consumption; excludes browser render/hydration, TLS/CDN and remote database/provider latency.
No concurrent builds, tests or browser automation during load. Shared host background activity was not controlled; historical 1.39-second p95 was not reliably reproduced.
One event per five seconds is not a delivery throughput certification. No 500-RPS or soak run was performed in this pass.
Trace percentiles are sampled and overlapping; SQL/acquisition/render percentiles must not be added. SQL timing includes network and driver decode. Residual server time is not pure CPU.

Raw output artifacts remain local; this document preserves summaries, source/build identifiers, hashes, all route/replica/window aggregates and limitations. Historical scaling-capacity.json is unchanged.

legacyReplay.limitation: Original skewed route/replica assignment and priming behavior, uncorrected latency decomposition. A single replay; not an isolated routing A/B.

queryPlans.note: Representative fixture SQL, not a claim to reproduce every Prisma hydration statement. Run without competing load.

results.name: navigationLinks
results.sql: SELECT c.id, c.title, c.handle FROM collections c WHERE c."isPublished" AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_products cp JOIN products p ON p.id = cp."productId" WHERE cp."collectionId" = c.id AND p."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND (p."publishedAt" IS NULL OR p."publishedAt" <= $1)) ORDER BY c."updatedAt" DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT 24

Plans.Filter: ((("publishedAt" IS NULL) OR ("publishedAt" <= '2026-09-24 16:50:55.99'::timestamp without time zone)) AND (status = 'ACTIVE'::"ProductStatus"))

results.name: removedNavigationCounts
results.sql: SELECT cp."collectionId", count(*) FROM collection_products cp JOIN products p ON p.id = cp."productId" WHERE p."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND (p."publishedAt" IS NULL OR p."publishedAt" <= $1) AND cp."collectionId" IN (SELECT id FROM collections WHERE "isPublished" ORDER BY "updatedAt" DESC, id ASC LIMIT 24) GROUP BY cp."collectionId"

Plans.Filter: ((("publishedAt" IS NULL) OR ("publishedAt" <= '2026-09-24 16:50:55.99'::timestamp without time zone)) AND (status = 'ACTIVE'::"ProductStatus"))

results.name: productPage
results.sql: SELECT p.* FROM products p WHERE p."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND (p."publishedAt" IS NULL OR p."publishedAt" <= $1) ORDER BY p."createdAt" DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT 24

Plans.Filter: ((("publishedAt" IS NULL) OR ("publishedAt" <= '2026-09-24 16:50:55.99'::timestamp without time zone)) AND (status = 'ACTIVE'::"ProductStatus"))
